title: Last U-Bahn home
intro: 2:04 a.m. Alexanderplatz. Your phone is dead, the station is empty, and the last U-Bahn to Pankow leaves in a few minutes. Listen for the platform: Gleis.
wrong: Wrong platform. That train goes to Spandau 🚇
Night bus. 90 minutes. Someone is eating a kebab next to you 🥙
Right platform… for the first train tomorrow morning ☀️

ending.name: Station announcement
ending.en: Stand back, please! (The doors close: you made it.)

clip.name: Station announcement
clip.de: Die nächste U-Bahn nach Pankow fährt von Gleis eins.
clip.en: The next U-Bahn to Pankow leaves from platform one.

clip.name: Station announcement
clip.de: Achtung, Gleiswechsel! Die U-Bahn nach Pankow fährt jetzt von Gleis eins.
clip.en: Attention, platform change! The U-Bahn to Pankow now leaves from platform one.

clip.name: Station announcement
clip.de: Letzte Durchsage: Die letzte U-Bahn nach Pankow, Gleis eins. Bitte beeilen Sie sich!
clip.en: Final call: the last U-Bahn to Pankow, platform one. Please hurry!
